acceptance_criteria.criterion: Self-referential and mutually cyclic supported arrays, plain objects, and Sets throw CanonicalEncoderError with the exact code and message documented by ADR-009; no native RangeError or uncontrolled recursion escapes.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: canonical.ts checks activeStack before descending, throws E_CYCLE, and removes active entries in finally blocks. hostile-cycle.test.mjs covers direct and cross-container cycles and asserts the documented code, message, and paths; the automated test run passes these tests.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A repeated reference that is not on the active traversal path is accepted and produces the same canonical bytes as the equivalent duplicated-by-value structure.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: activeStack entries are removed after each completed container traversal. hostile-cycle.test.mjs compares shared object, Array, and Set references against duplicated-by-value structures, and the automated suite passes.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: An enumerable own getter or setter on a top-level plain object, nested plain object, or null-prototype plain object throws E_ACCESSOR_DESCRIPTOR without invoking the accessor.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: encodePlainObject uses descriptor inspection and rejects accessor descriptors without accessing them. hostile-object.test.mjs covers top-level, nested, and null-prototype cases with zero-invocation assertions, and the automated suite passes.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Cycle detection, property-descriptor inspection, and traversal rely only on captured intrinsics and execute no user getter, setter, iterator override, or coercion hook.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: canonical.ts still performs dynamic intrinsic lookups during traversal, including activeStack.push/pop, entries.push/sort, elementBytes.push/sort, for-of iteration over this.parts, entries, and elementBytes, Uint8Array.prototype.set, String.prototype.charCodeAt/replace, and RegExp.prototype.test. A post-import override such as Array.prototype[Symbol.iterator] can therefore execute during ByteSink.finalize or object traversal. monkeypatch.test.mjs does not test these dependencies.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: All 157 pre-existing tests and all new focused tests pass.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Automated output reports 157 tests total. The Implementer states that only 44 are pre-existing and 113 are newly added, so it does not establish that 157 pre-existing tests plus the new focused tests pass. No Section 19 blocker record resolving the stated acceptance-criterion contradiction is included.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The exact candidate state passes the repository lint, strict compile/typecheck, and dependency-boundary commands.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Automated validation records npm ci, git diff --check, lint, and test only. It contains no npm run compile or npm run boundary execution and explicitly warns that no typecheck/build script was found. The Implementer report's claimed runs are not accompanied by independently recorded command output for the exact candidate state.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No StateHash or SaveHash implementation is added.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The candidate diff adds only CanonicalEncoder implementation, exports, ADR documentation, tests, and the test-script glob. StateHash and SaveHash appear only as future documentation references.

findings.evidence: canonical.ts dynamically invokes Array methods and iterators through activeStack.push/pop, entries.push/sort, elementBytes.push/sort, and for-of loops. It also dynamically invokes Uint8Array.prototype.set, String.prototype.charCodeAt/replace, and RegExp.prototype.test. These can be replaced after module import and execute attacker-controlled code, contradicting ADR-009 §1/§6 and the acceptance criterion requiring traversal to rely only on captured intrinsics.
findings.required_change: Capture every intrinsic used by validation, traversal, ordering, path construction, and output assembly at module initialization and invoke captured functions safely, or replace those operations with index-based logic that performs no mutable prototype lookup. Add focused tests that patch Array.prototype[Symbol.iterator], push, pop, sort, Uint8Array.prototype.set, and applicable String/RegExp methods after import, including cycle rejection paths, and assert zero hostile invocations and stable results.
findings.title: Traversal still depends on uncaptured mutable intrinsics

findings.evidence: The supplied automated validation has no compile or boundary sections. Only lint and test among the repository gates were executed, while the task explicitly requires compile and dependency-boundary commands on the exact candidate revision.
findings.required_change: Run and record npm run compile and npm run boundary on the exact candidate state, with successful exit codes and complete enough output to establish which commands executed. Re-run the other required gates on that same state if the candidate changes.
findings.title: Required compile and boundary evidence is missing

findings.evidence: The acceptance criterion requires all 157 pre-existing tests and all new tests to pass, but the Implementer reports 44 pre-existing plus 113 new tests, and automated validation confirms only 157 total. The claimed mismatch is a specification/task contradiction, but no Section 19 blocker record is included.
findings.required_change: Preserve and run the required pre-existing suite plus the new focused tests. If the accepted baseline demonstrably contains only 44 tests and the criterion is impossible as written, record and resolve the contradiction through the CICLO_SPEC.md §19 blocker protocol instead of silently reinterpreting 157 pre-existing as 157 total.
findings.title: Stated pre-existing test-count criterion is unresolved

invariants_checked: Active-path cycle rejection with shared-reference encode-by-value behavior
Accessor rejection without getter or setter invocation
risks: Post-import prototype monkeypatching can execute user code inside canonical encoding and can change output or failure behavior.
Tests import generated dist output, so without a recorded compile gate the tested JavaScript cannot be conclusively tied to the submitted TypeScript source.
The unresolved baseline-test-count mismatch may conceal omitted accepted regression tests.
payload.summary: The cycle and accessor behavior is substantially implemented, but the candidate does not satisfy the captured-intrinsics guarantee, lacks required recorded compile and boundary validation, and does not meet or formally block the stated pre-existing-test-count criterion.

missing: Successful recorded npm run compile on the exact candidate state
